name: Little Tree | 200mg Gummies | Grape
description:
4 Gummies | 50MG Each | Distillate

Our Grape Distillate Gummies combine bold, jammy fruit flavor with a smooth, balanced high. Each gummy contains 50MG of cannabis distillate for a consistent, straightforward experience that supports your pace.

With a chewy texture and playful grape finish, this gummy is a reliable favorite for casual moments and cozy evenings.

Whether you’re recharging or reconnecting—this gummy brings easy vibes to any situation.
